system.description:
Tianqi Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Very Rare, Rot. 1 item slot (Small, Worn, RIS Passive). Attunement.

A small piece of heavy paper, upon which a detailed Tianqi glyph emblazons the word “Power”. It is written in blood.

Strength of Blood (Passive): Choose one weapon to which this Glyph applies when it is in your RIS. Increase the damage dice of that weapon by 1 Dice Type. Additionally, it overcomes Nonmagical Damage Resistance.

Glyph Corruption (Passive): When you attune to this item, you permanently gain 1 Glyph Corruption (randomly). You retain this Glyph Corruption if you remove Attunement to this Glyph.

Rulebook p.65.
